grand_strategy.reading:
Serbia runs a hedging strategy with one fixed point - Kosovo - and everything else
negotiable. In Luttwak's terms the paradox is structural: the instrument that
protects the fixed point (Russian and Chinese cover at the UN) is the one that
blocks the declared strategic goal (EU membership), and the "neutrality" that
justifies the hedge is financed by the side the hedge is meant to keep at a
distance. Through 2025-26 the hedge stopped paying: the US sanctioned NIS, Russia
refused a long-term gas contract and accused Belgrade over ammunition, the EU
froze funds and talks after the Mladić funeral. Two signals worth watching that
are not rows: Vučić did not attend the 2026 Moscow parade, and in May 2026 Serbia
held its first-ever exercise with NATO on its own soil. The 25 Oct 2026 election
decides whether the strategy has an author at all.
